# Portfolio-Kayce

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Kay-ce Villaruel · Virtual assistant &amp; social media manager</title>
<meta name="description" content="Kay-ce (Dash) helps small businesses with admin, sales support, customer care and social media.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:opsz,wght@12..96,400;12..96,600;12..96,800&family=Newsreader:ital,opsz,wght@0,6..72,400;0,6..72,500;1,6..72,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--bg:#2B2726;--ink:#F3EDE8;--mute:#B3A59C;--line:#4A4240;--paper:#353130;--pink:#7A5650;--green:#E9C9C0;--on-green:#2B2726;
box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);color-scheme:dark}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);scroll-behavior:smooth}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:400 1.125rem/1.65 "Newsreader",Georgia,serif;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
h1,h2,h3,.sans{font-family:"Newsreader",Georgia,serif;font-weight:500}
a{color:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--green);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:4px}
.wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 clamp(1.25rem,5vw,3rem)}
header.top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:1.25rem 0}
.mark{font:500 1.25rem "Newsreader",serif;text-decoration:none;letter-spacing:-.01em}
nav a{font:600 .95rem "Bricolage Grotesque",sans-serif;text-decoration:none;margin-left:1.4rem;color:var(--mute)}
nav a:hover{color:var(--ink)}
@media(max-width:560px){nav a:not(.keep){display:none}}
.hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;gap:clamp(2rem,6vw,5rem);align-items:center;padding:clamp(2rem,6vw,4.5rem) 0 clamp(3rem,8vw,6rem)}
h1{font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(2.7rem,7.4vw,5.6rem);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0 0 1.5rem;max-width:11ch}
.lede{max-width:34rem;font-size:1.3rem;color:var(--ink);margin:0 0 2rem}
.lede span{background:linear-gradient(transparent 60%,var(--pink) 60%)}
.btns{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.8rem}
.btn{font:600 1rem "Bricolage Grotesque",sans-serif;text-decoration:none;padding:.85rem 1.35rem;border-radius:999px;border:2px solid var(--ink);display:inline-block;transition:transform .15s}
.btn.main{background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg)}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.visual{position:relative;padding:0 0 3.5rem 2rem}
.photo{width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/4;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 20%;border-radius:999px 999px 1.2rem 1.2rem;display:block;background:var(--pink)}
.todo{position:absolute;left:-1.5rem;bottom:0;width:min(21rem,92%);background:var(--paper);border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:.9rem;padding:1.1rem 1.2rem 1rem;transform:rotate(-2.5deg);box-shadow:6px 6px 0 var(--pink)}
.todo h2{font-size:.95rem;margin:0 0 .6rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--mute)}
.todo label{display:flex;gap:.7rem;align-items:center;font:400 1.02rem/1.35 "Newsreader",serif;padding:.28rem 0;cursor:pointer}
.todo input{appearance:none;flex:none;width:1.3rem;height:1.3rem;border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:.35rem;display:grid;place-items:center;margin:0;cursor:pointer;transition:background .25s}
.todo input:checked{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green)}
.todo input:checked::after{content:"";width:.35rem;height:.7rem;border:solid var(--on-green);border-width:0 2.5px 2.5px 0;transform:translateY(-1px) rotate(45deg)}
.todo label span{background:linear-gradient(var(--mute),var(--mute)) 0 55%/0 2px no-repeat;transition:background-size .5s,color .5s}
.todo input:checked+span{background-size:100% 2px;color:var(--mute)}
.todo p{margin:.7rem 0 0;font:600 .95rem "Bricolage Grotesque",sans-serif;color:var(--green);min-height:1.4em}
section{padding:clamp(3rem,8vw,6rem) 0;border-top:1.5px solid var(--line)}
.sec{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,13rem) 1fr;gap:clamp(1.5rem,5vw,4rem)}
@media(max-width:760px){.hero,.sec{grid-template-columns:1fr}.visual{max-width:26rem;padding-left:1.5rem}}
h2.t{font-size:clamp(1.9rem,4vw,2.7rem);line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-.015em;margin:0;font-weight:400}
.prose p{margin:0 0 1.2rem;max-width:38rem}
.prose .q{font-size:1.5rem;line-height:1.4;font-style:italic;max-width:30rem;margin:0 0 1.6rem}
details{border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line)}
details:first-of-type{border-top:1.5px solid var(--line)}
summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:grid;grid-template-columns:8.5rem 1fr 1.5rem;gap:1rem;align-items:baseline;padding:1.3rem 0}
summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
summary .yrs{font:600 .92rem "Bricolage Grotesque",sans-serif;color:var(--mute)}
summary .who{font:500 clamp(1.35rem,3vw,1.8rem) "Newsreader",serif;letter-spacing:-.01em;line-height:1.2}
summary .who small{display:block;font:400 1rem "Newsreader",serif;letter-spacing:0;color:var(--mute);margin-top:.2rem}
summary::after{content:"+";font:600 1.6rem "Bricolage Grotesque",sans-serif;transition:transform .25s}
details[open] summary::after{transform:rotate(45deg)}
.body{padding:0 0 1.8rem 9.5rem;max-width:46rem}
.body ul{margin:0 0 1rem;padding-left:1.2rem}
.body li{margin-bottom:.5rem}
.body .tools{font:600 .9rem "Bricolage Grotesque",sans-serif;color:var(--green)}
@media(max-width:640px){summary{grid-template-columns:1fr 1.5rem}summary .yrs{grid-column:1/2;order:-1}.body{padding-left:0}}
.skills{display:grid;gap:0}
.row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,11rem) 1fr;gap:1rem;padding:1.15rem 0;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line)}
.row:first-child{border-top:1.5px solid var(--line)}
.row h3{margin:0;font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:500}
.row p{margin:0;max-width:36rem}
.row .tools{display:block;margin-top:.3rem;color:var(--mute);font-size:1rem}
@media(max-width:640px){.row{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:.3rem}}
.contact{text-align:left}
.contact h2{font-size:clamp(2.2rem,6.4vw,4.6rem);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0 0 1.5rem;font-weight:400;max-width:15ch}
.contact .mail{font:600 clamp(1.1rem,3.4vw,1.7rem) "Bricolage Grotesque",sans-serif;word-break:break-all}
.contact ul{list-style:none;margin:1.5rem 0 0;padding:0;color:var(--mute)}
footer{padding:2rem 0 3rem;color:var(--mute);font-size:.95rem;border-top:1.5px solid var(--line)}
.rise{animation:rise .8s .1s both}
@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.rise{animation:none}html{scroll-behavior:auto}*{transition:none!important}}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<main id="top">

 <div class="rise">

  <div class="btns"><a class="btn main" href="mailto:kaycemonteliolavillaruel@gmail.com?subject=Let%E2%80%99s%20work%20together">Email me</a><a class="btn" href="#work">See what I’ve done</a></div>

 <h2 class="t">Where I’ve worked</h2>
 <div>
  <details open><summary><span class="yrs">Mar 2023 – Jul 2026</span><span class="who">DOM Solutions<small>B2B sales representative</small></span></summary>

  <details><summary><span class="yrs">Jul 2022 – Apr 2025</span><span class="who">Overland Remodeling and Builders<small>Virtual assistant and social media</small></span></summary>

<section id="about"><div class="sec">
 <h2 class="t">How I work</h2>
 <div class="prose">
  <p class="q">Your time and energy are precious, and running a business is already a lot.</p>
  <p>I’m the person who notices the thing slipping and picks it up before you have to ask. Calendars, inboxes, invoices, posts: I like the work that keeps everything else running smoothly, and I like it done carefully.</p>
  <p>I came to this through customer service and sales, so I’m used to being the voice a client hears. That’s why I write, schedule and follow up like someone who has to answer for it.</p>
  <p>I studied secondary education, majoring in English, at PUP Bansud Campus (2013–2017). I’m based in Oriental Mindoro, Philippines.</p>
 </div>
</div></section>

  <div class="row"><h3>Customer care</h3><p>Answering questions, calming escalations, keeping clients in the loop.<span class="tools">Zoho CRM · CallRail · 8x8</span></p></div>
  <div class="row"><h3>Social and email</h3><p>Scheduling posts, reels and graphics, newsletters and campaigns, LinkedIn profile management.<span class="tools">Canva · Mailchimp · Zoho Campaigns</span></p></div>

<script>
(function(){
var boxes=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.todo input')),msg=document.getElementById('done');
function check(){msg.textContent=boxes.every(function(b){return b.checked})?'All done. This is the part I take off your plate.':''}
boxes.forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener('change',check)});
if(!window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches){
 var touched=false;boxes.forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){touched=true})});
 boxes.forEach(function(b,i){setTimeout(function(){if(!touched){b.checked=true;check()}},1400+i*750)});
}
})();
</script>
